changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Historico inmutable de rol y de estado de cuenta (ARC-116): traza append-only con actor y fecha
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE usuario_historico ( history_id NUMBER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, user_id NUMBER NOT NULL, change_type VARCHAR2(20 CHAR) NOT NULL, previous_role_code VARCHAR2(32 CHAR), new_role_code VARCHAR2(32 CHAR), previous_status VARCHAR2(10 CHAR), new_status VARCHAR2(10 CHAR), reason_code VARCHAR2(30 CHAR), note VARCHAR2(500 CHAR), valid_from TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, valid_to TIMESTAMP(6), changed_by NUMBER NOT NULL, changed_at TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, event_type GENERATED ALWAYS AS (change_type) VIRTUAL, previous_value GENERATED ALWAYS AS (COALESCE(previous_role_code, previous_status)) VIRTUAL, new_value GENERATED ALWAYS AS (COALESCE(new_role_code, new_status)) VIRTUAL, CONSTRAINT pk_usuario_historico PRIMARY KEY (history_id), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_hist_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_hist_changed_by FOREIGN KEY (changed_by) REFERENCES usuario (user_id), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_hist_prev_role FOREIGN KEY (previous_role_code) REFERENCES cat_rol (role_code), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_hist_new_role FOREIGN KEY (new_role_code) REFERENCES cat_rol (role_code), CONSTRAINT fk_usuario_hist_reason FOREIGN KEY (reason_code) REFERENCES cat_motivo_desactivacion (reason_code) )

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Reglas de coherencia del historico: enumerados, valor anterior distinto del nuevo y motivo de baja
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE usuario_historico ADD CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_change_type CHECK (change_type IN ('ROL','ESTADO'))

ALTER TABLE usuario_historico ADD CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_status_enum CHECK ( (previous_status IS NULL OR previous_status IN ('ACTIVO','INACTIVO')) AND (new_status IS NULL OR new_status IN ('ACTIVO','INACTIVO')) )

ALTER TABLE usuario_historico ADD CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_coherencia CHECK ( (change_type = 'ROL' AND new_role_code IS NOT NULL AND previous_status IS NULL AND new_status IS NULL AND reason_code IS NULL AND ((previous_role_code IS NULL AND valid_to IS NULL) OR (previous_role_code IS NOT NULL AND valid_to = valid_from))) OR (change_type = 'ESTADO' AND new_status IS NOT NULL AND previous_role_code IS NULL AND new_role_code IS NULL) )

ALTER TABLE usuario_historico ADD CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_valor_distinto CHECK ( (previous_role_code IS NULL OR previous_role_code <> new_role_code) AND (previous_status IS NULL OR previous_status <> new_status) )

ALTER TABLE usuario_historico ADD CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_motivo CHECK ( (new_status = 'INACTIVO' AND reason_code IS NOT NULL) OR (new_status = 'ACTIVO' AND reason_code IS NULL) OR (change_type = 'ROL' AND reason_code IS NULL) )

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE usuario_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_motivo
ALTER TABLE usuario_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_valor_distinto
ALTER TABLE usuario_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_coherencia
ALTER TABLE usuario_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_status_enum
ALTER TABLE usuario_historico DROP CONSTRAINT ck_usuario_hist_change_type

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Invariantes de unicidad: una sola entrada de alta por usuario y una sola asignacion de rol vigente
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_usuario_hist_alta ON usuario_historico (CASE WHEN previous_role_code IS NULL AND previous_status IS NULL THEN user_id END)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_usuario_hist_rol_sin_cierre ON usuario_historico (CASE WHEN change_type = 'ROL' AND valid_to IS NULL THEN user_id END)

changeSet.author: MIND
changeSet.comment: Indice de la consulta del historico: por usuario y orden cronologico descendente
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_usuario_hist_user_changed_at ON usuario_historico (user_id, changed_at DESC)

changeSet.comment: Inmutabilidad del historico (REQ-015, REQ-065, REQ-077): UPDATE y DELETE rechazados con ORA-20001

changeSet.author: MIND

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id, valid_from AS vigente_desde, LEAD(valid_to) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY valid_from, history_id) AS vigente_hasta FROM usuario_historico WHERE change_type = 'ROL') a JOIN (SELECT user_id, valid_from AS vigente_desde, LEAD(valid_to) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY valid_from, history_id) AS vigente_hasta FROM usuario_historico WHERE change_type = 'ROL') b ON b.user_id = a.user_id AND b.vigente_desde > a.vigente_desde AND (a.vigente_hasta IS NULL OR a.vigente_hasta > b.vigente_desde)
